_description: Controlled vocabulary of moods. Every book is tagged with 1-4 of these. `color` is a hint for the design layer (a book can still override with its own cover-extracted color-world).

moods.label: Comforting
moods.description: Warm, gentle, a soft place to land.

moods.label: Unsettling
moods.description: Uneasy, uncanny, gets under the skin.

moods.label: Playful
moods.description: Witty, inventive, light on its feet.

moods.label: Romantic
moods.description: Yearning, passionate, love in many forms.

moods.label: Epic
moods.description: Sweeping in scale, time, or place.

moods.label: Quiet
moods.description: Slow, interior, small in the best way.

moods.label: Dreamlike
moods.description: Surreal, fluid, logic of a dream.

moods.label: Haunting
moods.description: Lingers after the last page; ghostly.

moods.label: Satirical
moods.description: Sharp, funny, biting at the world.
